elements.manual_reason: The multilingual greeting bubbles exit upward out of frame by f1045 and are absent from the end frame; box covers the full frame they occupied at f1038.
elements.label: Multilingual greeting bubbles ('Hallo!', 'Bonjour', 'Hey!', 'Привет!')

pattern.description: A fast vertical whip: the cluster of multilingual greeting bubbles shoots up out of frame (energy peaks in the first ~6 frames), leaving an empty field; fresh spheres drift up from below and the two-line headline 'With Loom AI, / make your first take' fades up line by line, the second line held at reduced opacity.
pattern.why_premium: The whip reads as the whole world scrolling upward rather than a cut, keeping the floating-sphere universe continuous between scenes; the brief empty beat before the headline gives the line room to land, and the dimmed second line sets up a two-tone emphasis that later beats can complete.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.greeting-bubbles',{yPercent:-150,filter:'blur(6px)',duration:0.25,ease:'power3.in'}); tl.fromTo('.sphere',{y:300},{y:0,duration:0.9,ease:'power3.out',stagger:0.05},'-=0.05'); tl.fromTo('.line1',{opacity:0,y:16},{opacity:1,y:0,duration:0.4,ease:'power2.out'},'-=0.5'); tl.fromTo('.line2',{opacity:0,y:16},{opacity:0.45,y:0,duration:0.4,ease:'power2.out'},'-=0.2'); wrap scene in a container scaled 1→0.9 (pull-out) over the whole move.
build_hint.remotion: Bubbles: interpolate(frame,[0,7],[0,-1.5*height],{easing:Easing.in(Easing.cubic)}) on translateY. Spheres: spring({frame:frame-6-i, fps, config:{damping:26, stiffness:100}}) mapped to translateY 300→0. Lines: spring (no overshoot) delayed ~15 and ~25 frames mapped to opacity (line 2 capped at 0.45) and translateY 16→0. Container scale interpolate(frame,[0,42],[1,0.9]).

notes: No SFX candidates in the packet; the spectrogram shows only the music bed. The greeting bubbles are listed as one group with a full-frame manual box because they leave the frame; camera reports pull_out with a large vertical pan (pan_y -1.95), so the exit may be a camera tilt rather than object motion. Line 1 vs line 2 reveal could be word-level (diff boxes b10-b17 split words); filmstrip only shows line-level steps. Shot s009 starts at f1038 per the filmstrip header, so this event may straddle a cut-like whip.
